toolbox.title: What is ToolBox?
toolbox.desc: ToolBox is a set of tools for everyday tasks. You can choose the right tool from the home page or the sidebar.

interface.title: How the interface works
interface.desc: On the left is the navigation panel with tools and sections. In the center is the workspace. In settings you can change the theme, avatar, language, and more.

renamer.title: File renamer
renamer.subtitle: Bulk renames files using the pattern: prefix + sequence number + suffix. The result is downloaded as a ZIP archive.
steps: Click “Upload files” or drag files into the upload area. Maximum 100 files at a time.
Enter a prefix (before the number) and suffix (after the number). Example: photo_ and _2025 → photo_01_2025.jpg.
Check the preview result in the “Before” and “After” columns.
Click “Download” — the files will be downloaded as a ZIP archive with new names (file quality and size remain unchanged).
hints: The “Add files” button at the bottom allows you to extend the list without resetting it. “Clear” completely resets the list.

shortener.title: Link shortener
shortener.subtitle: Turns long URLs into short ones. Supports social sharing, clipboard copy, and QR code generation.
steps: Paste a link into the “Long URL” field and click “Shorten”.
Copy the result using the “Copy” button or share it directly via VK, Telegram, or WhatsApp.
Click “QR code” — an image will appear that you can save with a screenshot.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.text: Click on the photo, choose one from the grid, and confirm with the “Apply avatar” button.

profile.title: Name and email
profile.text: Click the corresponding field, enter a new value, and press the save icon.

password.title: Password
password.text: Click “Change password”, fill in all three fields, and save.

appearance.title: Theme and language
appearance.text: Choose the appropriate option from the dropdown list.

faq.question: Why is the “Download” button disabled?
faq.answer: The button becomes active only after at least one file has been added.

faq.question: Can I add more than 100 files?
faq.answer: No, the current limit is 100 files per batch. For larger volumes, split the files into several groups.

faq.question: Are my files uploaded to the server?
faq.answer: No. Renaming happens directly in the browser, and the files never leave your device.

faq.question: The link is not shortening — what should I do?
faq.answer: Make sure the URL starts with https:// and is a valid address. If the error persists, try again later.
